original: Yeah! We need to find a way out,\nsomehow.
Don't worry about it! Everyone's\nstomach growls at one point or\nanother.
Ah, I'm Takato Matsuda. Looks like\nwe both have Digimon.
Yeah! I'm Taichi Yagami... and\nthis is Agumon!
I-It's nothing... You just, uh,\nhappen to have the same name as a\nreally famous person I know.
Whoaaaaa! It's Agumon! Takato has\na figure of you in his room!
I'm Hackmon! I love fighting\nstrong guys!
I love eating bread at Takato's\nplace!
Well... I was taking some of our\nbread to Guilmon after school...
And while I was eating the bread,\na big fuzzy thing appeared!
And before we knew it, we were\nhere...
So it was that black shadow\nagain...
What do you want from us? Let us\nout!
Yeah, what do you want from us?
You must fight... defeat the\nenemies, and go further in... or\nelse...
Heeeeey! Don't run away! Fight me!
It said we need to go in further.
We don't have to do what he says.
But we have to keep going if we\nwanna get out of here, right?
I guess our only choice is to do\nwhat it says...
I guess that's our only option.\nWe'll do whatever we can in order\nto escape.
Yeah, we'll feel better having you\nguys around.
You got to meet Taichi and Agumon,\nso why aren't you saying anything?
What, that I already know who they\nare?
If I say that, that's only going\nto confuse him!
It's gonna be a big shock for him\nif I tell him about Digimon being\nall the rage in our world!
Anyway, just being in the presence\nof people I admire so much is good\nenough for me...
Breaktime's gonna be over soon!\nLet's go!
I wonder if all my friends at\nschool will believe me if I tell\nthem about this...
Remember, we're keeping this a\nsecret from him!
Whaaaaa? Why is there another me?
We did it, but that was hard...
Hey! Don't treat this like some\nkind of game!
Now's our chance to leave! I guess\nwe're going to have to split off,\nTakato.
I guess we're supposed to be\nmeeting someone new on every\nlevel.
I see... Um, excuse me, but can I\nask you for a favor, Taichi?
Aaaaaah! I shook Taichi's hand!\nThank you so much!
I... have no idea what's going on,\nbut hey, I'm glad you're happy.
We'll find a way out, okay?
I wanna eat more of your family\nbread, Takato!
Yeah! We'll have to find a way\nhome, no matter what!
